notes: CHANGED on stock, unchanged on price. USD 4.49 a month is the published price and 3 vCore / 6 GB DDR5 / 100 GB NVMe / 20 TB is the shape, but the order page for the SKU (server 349) reads 'Out of Stock!' in the body, so the plan cannot be bought today. That is why this is a caveat rather than a qualification: the number is real and the cart is closed. Two further things the incumbent row did not carry. (1) The IPv4 is NAT with only 20 ports, so it is not a normal VPS for anything needing more than 20 inbound ports. (2) The German order page shows a term ladder from €3.90 to €104.13, which suggests annual prepay around €104.13, but the rungs are not labelled with their periods on that page, so no annual-divided-by-12 figure is claimed here. Worst case exposure is not computable while the SKU is out of stock and the term ladder is unlabelled.
